prompt: A train travels 240 km in 4 hours. If it increases its speed by 20 km/h, how long will it take to travel the same 240 km? Show all work.

result.reasoning: We need to solve: original speed = distance/time = 240/4 = 60 km/h. Increase by 20 km/h => new speed = 80 km/h. Time = distance / speed = 240/80 = 3 hours. Show all work. Provide explanation.

phase_meta.title: Train speed word problem
phase_meta.notes: Original speed=60 km/h, new speed=80 km/h, 240/80=3 hours
